verdict.rationale: Dagster pipelines are Python code: assets are declared as Python functions [dagster-docs-1, dagster-docs-17, dagster-docs-26]. Projects are scaffolded as ordinary repos via the create-dagster CLI [dagster-docs-2, dagster-docs-18], and component config lives in defs.yaml files [dagster-docs-41]. Portability is supported by OSS Docker deployment with code locations [dagster-docs-12], and community posts back a laptop-to-prod workflow and development branches [dagster-comm-8, dagster-comm-5]. Missing for 10: explicit docs on Git/version-control and code-review workflows (e.g., branch deployments tied to PRs), and independent hands-on evidence of moving projects between environments.
